title: LMS Filter
text: 使用最小均方 (LMS) 自适应算法计算输出、误差和权重，输入 5 路、输出 3 路、无直接馈通；按 {Algorithm} 指定算法；{Filter length} 指定滤波器长度、{Specify step size via} 指定步长的方式、{Step size (mu)} 指定步长、{Leakage factor (0 to 1)} 指定泄漏因子、{Initial value of filter weights} 指定滤波器权重的初始值、{Adapt port} 启用 Adapt 端口、{Reset port} 指定复位端口 None、{Output filter weights} 输出滤波器权重、{Rounding mode} 指定舍入运算的方法、{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定溢出操作的方法、{Parameters} 指定参数 Same word length as first、{Weights} 指定滤波器权重的字长和小数长度 Same as first、{Product and quotient} 指定乘积和商的字长和小数长度 Same as first、{Accumulator} 指定累加器的字长和小数长度 Same as first、{Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型，按实例取值。

ports.name: Input
ports.summary: 输入信号 scalar | column vector

ports.name: Desired
ports.summary: 期望信号 scalar | column vector

ports.name: Output
ports.summary: 期望信号的估计值 scalar | column vector

ports.name: Error
ports.summary: 输出信号与期望信号之间的误差 scalar | column vector

ports.name: Wts
ports.summary: 滤波器权重 scalar | column vector

params.name: Algorithm
params.values: 选择算法 LMS (default) | Normalized LMS | Sign-Error LMS | Sign-Data LMS | Sign-Sign LMS

params.name: Specify step size via
params.values: 指定步长的方式 Dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Initial value of filter weights
params.values: 滤波器权重的初始值 0 (default) | vector | scalar

params.name: Adapt port
params.values: 启用 Adapt 端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Reset port
params.values: 复位端口 None (default) | Rising edge | Falling edge | Either edge | Non-zero sample

params.name: Output filter weights
params.values: 输出滤波器权重 on (default) | off

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: 舍入运算的方法 Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 溢出操作的方法 off (default) | on

params.name: Parameters
params.values: 参数 Same word length as first input (default) | Specify word length | Binary point scaling

params.name: Weights
params.values: 滤波器权重的字长和小数长度 Same as first input (default) | Binary point scaling

params.name: Product and quotient
params.values: 乘积和商的字长和小数长度 Same as first input (default) | Binary point scaling

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: 累加器的字长和小数长度 Same as first input (default) | Binary point scaling

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型 off (default) | on
